Thanks for the pull request.

Epistl is in **active early development** and is **not accepting external pull requests** at this time. Development is driven by an internal agent harness; outside code PRs bypass that flow.

We **do** welcome:

- Bug reports via the [Bug report](https://github.com/mikef-eng/epistl/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) form
- Feature requests via the [Feature request](https://github.com/mikef-eng/epistl/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) form

Please report security issues privately — see [SECURITY.md](../blob/main/SECURITY.md).

More detail: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Closing this PR now.
